bakedReceivers.decision: World surfaces take only the models' sun shadows where the world does not already shade them, scaled by how much of each surface's light is the sun's; models keep all shadows. All three renderers, every game.
bakedReceivers.profiles: all sixteen; q3-ihv has no sun, so its shadows stay off

implementation.atlas: CSM_ATLAS_LAYERS 2: row 0 the world entity's casters, row 1 every other entity's

receivers.CSM_RECEIVER_ALL: models and light-grid surfaces: either row, by the sun colour
receivers.CSM_RECEIVER_LIGHTMAP: lightmap stage: models' row where the world's row is lit, by r_csmShadowStrength x share
receivers.CSM_RECEIVER_VERTEX: rgbGen vertex/exactVertex, MoHAA map colours: as lightmap
receivers.CSM_RECEIVER_NONE: full bright, constant or entity colour: no sun shadow

implementation.share: clamp(S x max(0, N . toSun) / max(L, 1/255), 0, 1) per channel
implementation.debug: r_csmDebug 1 adds baked:N after recv world:W ent:E

sunUnits.method: per sun-facing planar lightmapped surface, unsaturated luxels split by luma (2-means), both halves >= 15 %, step hue within 0.995 of the sun colour; step / (S x cos)

skySunUnits.problem: RT_FindSun scaled a sky sun to unit length unless it knew the map for q3map2's, so Wolfenstein's suns (stored at a brightest channel of 1) traced too dim; the raster took the profile alone, so q3map2-compiled Quake III maps took unit length
